hero.title: Meet PicetaAI - AI for Photo Management
hero.subtitle: Use AI to take control of your photo workflow.

features.sectionTitle: Smart Features to Simplify Photo Management
features.sectionDescription: PicetaAI blends advanced AI with a user-friendly design to help you find, organize, and clean up your photo library effortlessly.

features.title: AI-Powered Image Search
features.description: Find images instantly using text prompts or similar images.
features.content: Just describe the photo or upload a similar one — AI will quickly find the match from your library.

features.title: Search with Natural Language
features.description: Talk to your photo library like you would to a friend.
features.content: Type or say things like 'Show beach photos from last summer' — PicetaAI understands and delivers instantly.

features.title: Clean Up Duplicate Photos
features.description: Automatically detect and remove duplicate or similar images.
features.content: Keep your library tidy and save storage by letting AI handle redundant photos.

features.title: Chat with AI About Your Photos
features.description: Get smart suggestions and insights just by asking.
features.content: Ask questions like 'How many photos did I take in Paris?' or 'Which albums need sorting?' and let AI assist you.

howItWorks.sectionDescription: Discover how PicetaAI makes finding and managing your images effortless.

steps.title: Describe or Upload
steps.description: Use natural language to describe what you're looking for or upload a similar image.

steps.title: AI Processing
steps.description: Our on-device AI analyzes your request and searches through your image collection.

steps.title: Instant Results
steps.description: Get accurate results instantly, with no data ever leaving your device.

qualityAssessment.sectionDescription: Our state-of-the-art AI evaluates your images based on both aesthetic and technical factors, all while running completely on your device for maximum privacy.

qualityFactors.title: Aesthetic Evaluation
qualityFactors.description: Analyzes composition, color harmony, and visual appeal

qualityFactors.title: Technical Analysis
qualityFactors.description: Measures sharpness, noise levels, and exposure accuracy

qualityFactors.title: Comparative Scoring
qualityFactors.description: Ranks similar images to identify the highest quality version

qualityFactors.title: Smart Recommendations
qualityFactors.description: Suggests which images to keep based on quality scores

steps.title: AI-Powered Quality Check
steps.description: Automatically assess image quality, sharpness, and composition.

steps.title: Advanced Filtering
steps.description: Filter images by quality, content, or custom criteria for fast curation.

steps.title: Privacy-First Assessment
steps.description: All analysis happens on-device for complete privacy and security.

qualityAssessment.whyMattersDesc: When you take multiple similar photos, it can be challenging to decide which one to keep. PicetaAI's Image Quality Assessment eliminates the guesswork by objectively analyzing each image and providing a quality score. This helps you maintain only the best images in your collection, saving storage space while preserving your most valuable memories.

testimonials.sectionDescription: Hear from our beta testers who've experienced the power of PicetaAI.
testimonials.alexJohnsonContent: PicetaAI has completely transformed how I organize my photo library. The natural language search is like magic - I can find any photo just by describing it!
testimonials.mariaNguyenContent: I love that all the image processing happens on my device. PicetaAI gives me powerful tools while keeping my data private.
testimonials.chrisLeeContent: The duplicate cleanup and quality assessment features are a game changer. My workflow is so much faster now!
testimonials.sarahChenContent: As someone with thousands of reference images, the duplicate cleanup feature has saved me so much storage space. The privacy-first approach is exactly what I needed.
testimonials.michaelRodriguezContent: The AI chat feature helps me find and manage my photos. It's like having a personal assistant that understands my photo collection.

privacy.sectionDescription: Your data never leaves your device. All AI processing happens locally.
privacy.onDeviceDesc: All AI operations run directly on your device, ensuring your images never leave your control.
privacy.noCloudDesc: Unlike other apps, we don't store your images in the cloud. Your photos stay on your device.
privacy.offlineDesc: PicetaAI processes your data locally even without an internet connection. Your privacy is never compromised.
